verdict.rationale: Docs and runtime probes confirm agents can be created and managed via API, a real CLI (@elevenlabs/cli, verified live on npm), and a hosted MCP server (verified live with OAuth), all without the dashboard (docs-1,3,4,27,28,38; probe-rt-1,2). Phone-number attachment is also supported via SIP trunking to route calls to agents (docs-12,36), but there is no explicit documentation or evidence of actually placing/initiating an outbound call end-to-end through the API/CLI/MCP — only routing inbound infrastructure integration is described. Missing for 10: explicit API/CLI/MCP call to place an outbound call, and a concrete end-to-end walkthrough combining create+attach+call in one non-dashboard flow.
